name: GCP — Service Account Key Created (Persistence)
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = google_cloud_logging_raw
| filter xdm.event.operation_sub_type = "google.iam.admin.v1.CreateServiceAccountKey"
| bin _time span = 1h
| comp count() as keys_created,
       values(xdm.source.user.username) as users,
       values(xdm.event.type) as operations,
       values(xdm.event.description) as events_seen
       by xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, users, events_seen
description: google.iam.admin.v1.CreateServiceAccountKey method — new SA key created, providing persistent credential access.
alert_description:
What fired: google.iam.admin.v1.CreateServiceAccountKey method — new SA key created, providing persistent credential access.

Why it matters: this activity is anomalous and warrants review. Assessed severity: High.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1098.001 - Account Manipulation: Additional Cloud Credentials (TA0003 - Persistence).

Investigate:
  - Identify the primary entity and the behaviour that triggered the rule.
  - Correlate related alerts and events for the same entity within this window before escalating.
  - Pivot on the alert's key entity (xdm.source.ipv4) to related activity in the same window.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized for the involved entity before escalating.
